title: Functions and messaging
summary: Choose a service by workload and make handlers safe to repeat; retries alone do not make processing safe.

http.clue: The binding that starts a Function when a web request arrives

commands.clue: The enterprise broker for business commands that need queues, dead lettering and transactions

notifications.clue: The event-routing service for reacting to notifications such as a newly created blob

telemetry.clue: The partitioned ingestion service for high-volume telemetry streams

repeat.clue: The property that processing the same operation again does not repeat its intended side effect
